protocol: Only replace physical parent C0 by the retained C1; SAME bank, reference bank, residual units, full SU2/A1 decoder and H kernel. One primary direction per neural/free arm, FIT64 population E plus COMPLETE finite-Q R full/even/odd, same resolved192-record geometry and damping. No four-method force ladder, new head, longer trajectory, ED or GPU. Actual JVP/FD use complete two-sided E and R. Known FIT/GEO records are not validation. Fresh128 calibration only AFTER both directions sealed; ONE new128 audit shared by every constructed candidate. All previous audits are consumed and never called untouched again.
carrier_definition: C1=aC0+bHC0; HC1=aHC0+bH2C0, SAME total216-bond H. Centered neural state C1+s(Phi(theta)-Phi(reference)), with exact S=0 and all432 A1 images. Reuse known exact power products and Jacobians; compute new H2C0 only for fresh calibration/audit. No H3 approximation or population-R claim. Positive Q sampling uses the cheaper fixed C0 density plus its exchange bridge and uniform floor; exact Q and reweighting retained for C1 and every candidate.
filter_control: Continue the SAME degree-one positive spectral filter of C0, not H acting once more on C1 and not optimized two-Lanczos. Direction fixed by saved Eanchor and C0/HC0 powers before fresh data. beta increases from retained beta to at most .75/(B-Eanchor), preserving filter amplitude >=.25 on [-B,B]. Its ratio to the retained positive filter decreases with spectral energy, hence true normalized energy cannot increase. Variance not certified; strict zero-energy-tolerance/nonincreasing-variance policy remains. Both neural/free and filter use max sampled per-chain FS .01, one13-probe search and at most one candidate; response underfill is reported, not called equal-distance improvement.
evaluation: Report C1-relative energy/variance plus paired comparison against frozen continued-filter candidate, independently of retention. Read out tangent fraction outside span(C0,HC0) without altering model directions. Accept neural endpoint only if it passed calibration and strict independent C1 quality/chain-FS gates. Two paired SE energy improvement and nonworsening point variance versus the filter is a separate extra-gain diagnostic, not assumed from linear independence. All candidates including calibration rejects retained/evaluated; no post-audit refit, phase optimization or best-method selection.
budget: One64-center four-RHS pullback per arm; reuse64FIT+128GEO Jacobians and192 known H powers. One192-center H-JVP per arm,8FD centers/arm,13 amplitude probes and at most one192-center candidate/arm. Shared128 calibration and128 audit from fixed C0 Q; new H2C0 on only those256 centers. No new fitting samples or H3. Process wall<=1800s, RSS<=8GiB. Full-H evaluations and analytic baseline costs separately reported; no GPU-hours or method-cost equality asserted.
